# Gradmire

> Gradmire is a study-abroad counselling company for students in India. It helps students compare courses, universities, scholarships and destinations, prepare for tests, apply and plan their visas, and offers a free consultation. Registered office: World Trade Tower, Barakhamba Lane, New Delhi 110001. Email: info@gradmire.com.

## Destinations
- [Study abroad destinations](https://www.gradmire.com/destinations): compare countries
- [Study in the UK](https://www.gradmire.com/study-in-uk)

- [Study in Canada](https://www.gradmire.com/study-in-canada)

- [MBBS abroad](https://www.gradmire.com/mbbs-abroad): fees, countries and recognition
